spanish: Bandera de campamento de Efraín a sus ejércitos yamah; y príncipe a hijos de Efraín, Elishamá hijo de Amihud.

findings.issue: Common noun יָמָּה (H3220, masculine singular + directional suffix) is left as the untranslated form yamah. The token licenses sea plus direction toward it, not a dumped lemma.

notes: Remaining tokens match number, person, constructs, and the locked name Efraín.
